title: Jaaliiɗo Hakkunde Horizons Ɗiɗi
intro: E nder defte njiimaandi Alla, limre wootere ina darii heen, ko laamɗo baawɗo, kadi ko maccuɗo Alla lesɗikiniiɗo. Oo neɗɗo yahri ko to woɗɗi e leydi, ina seedtoo naange ina fuɗa e dow leñol ngol alaa ɗo haaɗi, ina fadi haa ɓuuɓol ɓalewol murtungol. Ko ɓuri haawnaade heen, oo maccuɗo halfinaa ko mahde damal keeringal ngam haɓaade leñol bonngol mawngol. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ooɗoo limre legendaire e nder Quraana?
clues: Mi hokkaama baawɗe e baawɗe e dow leydi ko Joom yurmeende
Mi yahi to nokku ɗo naange fuɗata e ɗo muttata
Mi yettiima leñol ngol waawataa faamde hay konngol gootol
Mi yamiraama yo mi mah barmeeji mawɗi kuutortooɗi njamndi
Mi siifi nokku hakkunde kooseeje ɗiɗi ɓutte ɗee e njamndi mboɗeeri
Mi wonaano maleyka, mi wonaano annabi, kono ko mi maccuɗo mo Alla facciri

trial.label: Golle Mawɗe
options: Pewnugol njamndi mawndi ngam haɓaade Yajuj e Majuj
Pewnugol laana e nder ilam mawɗam
trial.answer: Pewnugol njamndi mawndi ngam haɓaade Yajuj e Majuj

outcome.label: Fodoore Alla
options: Aljanna duumotooɗo hokkaama ɗoon e ɗoon
Baroowo oo ina jokki haa ñalnde darnga
Ndimaagu e maayde wonande gooŋɗinɓe fof
outcome.answer: Baroowo oo ina jokki haa ñalnde darnga

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
